newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTFAIRS, KLEMENTI MOVE TO OFFICIAL LISTS.
newsitem.headline: ESTFAIRS, KLEMENTI MOVE TO OFFICIAL LISTS.

text.p: Estonian Fairs and textile company Klementi are to be traded on Tallinn Stock Exchange from May 20, the bourse said on Wednesday.

"The stock exchange listing commission approved Klementi's application to include its shares on the secondary list and Estonian Fairs' application to go to main list," Helo Meigas, the bourse's managing director, told Reuters.
Until now the Estonian Fairs has been traded on the free market of the Tallinn Stock Exchange.
Klementi, traded on OTC market before, had a net turnover of 86.4 million kroons and a net profit of 4.3 million kroons in 1996.
It sees 1997 net turnover rising to 97.5 million kroons and net profit reaching 7.5 million kroons.
